steps.en: After rights and recovery review, prepare A and B in a disposable desktop environment
steps.zh: 许可与恢复审查后，在临时桌面环境准备 A、B

steps.en: Choose a saved or empty identity and what stays shared; save unfinished work
steps.zh: 选已存或空身份与共享范围，先保存未完成工作

steps.en: Confirm archiving and switching, including recognized-client closure
steps.zh: 确认归档与切换，允许关闭已识别客户端

steps.en: Stop recognized clients; verify the target and save/authenticate outgoing state
steps.zh: 停已识别客户端，验收目标并保存、验收当前状态

component.zh: 原生存储层与加密归档

steps.en: Journal recovery state, replace selected files and restore target credentials
steps.zh: 记录恢复状态，替换所选文件并恢复目标凭据

steps.en: Commit the identity/profile choice; reopen the linked browser or report the failure
steps.zh: 提交身份与资料选择，重开关联浏览器或报告失败

value.en: Selected default Claude state moves without manual folder juggling; recovery remains conditional
value.zh: 不再手动搬默认 Claude 状态；恢复仍有条件，不是保证
